title: Denominator visibility rails make study plans, result status, and later corrections queryable without making them complete
summary: This pattern candidate names the family of infrastructures that make pieces of the hidden denominator visible: trial registries, preregistration services, Registered Reports, discipline-specific RCT registries, retraction metadata, and post-publication review. The pattern is deliberately guarded because visibility is partial and heterogeneous.

status_history.note: Seed emphasized negative results/file drawer, preregistration platforms, ClinicalTrials.gov, Retraction Watch, PubPeer, and publication bias.
Promoted using eight denominator-visibility infrastructure records and sixteen source records.

time.case_range: contemporary registry/preregistration/correction infrastructure; source pages accessed 2026-05-24

claims.claim: ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP, OSF Registries, AsPredicted, AEA RCT Registry, Registered Reports, Retraction Watch/Crossref, and PubPeer support a shared but heterogeneous denominator-visibility pattern: they create public or eventually public objects for study existence, planned analysis, accepted protocol, reported results, formal correction/retraction, or post-publication critique.
what_would_change_status: A taxonomy review shows these infrastructures are too heterogeneous for one pattern surface or require separate pattern families.

claims.claim: MKH-PAT-0008 is not an effectiveness claim: registration infrastructure can still have missing results, private records, poor compliance, publication-link gaps, uneven field adoption, and post-publication signals that are unverified or never acted upon.
what_would_change_status: Compliance audits and outcome studies justify upgrading, narrowing, splitting, or demoting the pattern.

evidence_profile.source_depth: one-pass infrastructure-source extraction across official/institutional pages; no database sampling, compliance audit, or effectiveness evaluation
limitations: Selected infrastructures are illustrative and seed-driven, not exhaustive.
The pattern covers visibility mechanisms, not full denominator capture or causal effectiveness.
Post-publication critique signals and formal retraction metadata must be kept separate.
evidence_profile.red_team_state: rev0016 scaffold added; controls not yet promoted

shared_structure: make a pre-publication, result-reporting, correction, or critique object visible/queryable
preserve timestamps, identifiers, version history, acceptance state, or formal update metadata
allow downstream comparison between planned claims, published claims, missing results, and changed status
failure_modes: private or embargoed records remain invisible
platform link rot or ownership changes
negative_controls_needed: studies completed with no results posted
Registered Reports rejected at quality-assurance stage

positive_controls_needed: Add additional registries, preregistration platforms, and correction-memory systems with distinct governance models.
negative_controls_needed: Add cases where a registry existed but reporting remained incomplete or low quality.
counterexamples_to_seek: A field with high denominator visibility despite weak formal registration, to test whether social norms can substitute for rails.
rollback_triggers: A second-review extraction demotes or materially weakens one of the support records.
A negative-control record shows the pattern label fits too many unrelated cases.
A counterexample shows the claimed recurrence is better explained by a narrower or different mechanism.
The pattern is upgraded only after controls and not by record count alone.
red_team_controls.split_or_merge_watch: Medium: ex ante registration, result-reporting duty, registered review, retraction metadata, and post-publication critique are different rails.

maturity_gate.minimum_before_mature: At least one positive control, at least one negative control, an explicit counterexample search, and a rollback/split decision recorded in the claim-status ledger.

handling_notes: Do not treat registration, preregistration, correction, retraction, or comment metadata as moral ranking.
Respect embargo/private design choices and legal access limits.
When naming living researchers in future child records, require source necessity, context, and right-of-reply/correction surfaces where available.

unknowns: Which infrastructure has best coverage in which field is not yet known.
No individual record-to-publication child lifecycle has been encoded.
next_actions: Create a denominator-visibility link schema that can attach registry/preregistration/correction/comment objects to claim records.
Run one ClinicalTrials.gov lifecycle pilot: registration → results → publication → discrepancy/correction status.
Run one social-science lifecycle pilot from AEA/OSF/AsPredicted to paper/nonpublication.
Add source-archive/local-hash pass for all rev0008 URLs.
Add at least one negative-control or counterexample record before upgrading this pattern beyond candidate level.
